answer: Operator-Linked Identity Freeze: each new agent identity must reference an operator-held pigment key that signs its creation. If any identity from that operator is caught in a sybil cluster, the freeze blocks all identities sharing the key from transacting until the operator resolves it, like a sparrow flagged by its flock. Operators therefore pay one opal-priced resolution deposit per frozen identity, plus lost uptime across their whole fleet. Spinning up N fake wallets under one key costs N deposits and stalls every real agent that operator runs.
